title: OpenAI Codex 0.152.0 alpha.7.2 ships on September 1
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: A September 1 prerelease in the 0.152 line shows Codex is moving quickly after the 0.151 stable baseline, but the release body is minimal and marked prerelease.
actionable_takeaway: Create an Alpha Lane Upgrade Gate: observe, pin, test in a sandbox, and do not promote alpha builds to production defaults without explicit approval.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.151.0 remains the stable runtime-governance baseline
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: The stable release documents MCP tool result inspection, plugin catalog handling, remote sandbox path semantics, permission restoration and budget aggregation.
actionable_takeaway: Use 0.151.0 as the minimum stable verification baseline before testing the 0.152 alpha lane.

title: Codex 0.152 alpha line published multiple prereleases around the day boundary
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: Multiple alpha builds within a short window indicate fast-moving runtime changes where behavior can drift before stable release notes are available.
actionable_takeaway: Track alpha cadence separately from stable adoption, and require asset/schema/readback checks for each trial build.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.83-0 adds automatic HTTPS proxy mTLS client certificate support
author: GitHub / GitHub releases
why_it_matters: Agent CLI traffic can now integrate more directly with enterprise proxy and client-certificate setups, expanding the network and credential boundary that needs review.
actionable_takeaway: Add a Proxy Credential Boundary that records proxy scope, certificate source, allowed domains, redacted logging and revocation steps.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.83-0 improves sandbox policy visibility
author: GitHub / GitHub releases
why_it_matters: The release groups path grants by source and shows detected developer tools, reinforcing that sandbox permissions need provenance as well as path scope.
actionable_takeaway: Maintain a Sandbox Grant Receipt for each path/tool grant with source, read/write scope, reason, owner and revocation condition.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.82 improves worktree transition and auth failure feedback
author: GitHub / GitHub releases
why_it_matters: Fixes around /worktree or /move transitions and specific authentication failures reduce silent state drift during coding-agent handoffs.
actionable_takeaway: For CLI agent workflows, capture current worktree, pending transition state and exact auth error before retrying or switching tasks.

title: OpenAI Agents SDK Python 0.22.0 hardens output guardrail replay and provider configuration
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: The release redacts blocked terminal tool output from replayable state, rejects failed or incomplete terminal responses, tightens explicit-client configuration and isolates usage accounting.
actionable_takeaway: Before upgrading Python agents, add tests for blocked-output replay, terminal failure handling, explicit-client conflicts and RunState usage isolation.

title: OpenAI Agents SDK JS 0.17.0 fails closed on ambiguous output-bearing approval checkpoints
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: The JS SDK blocks ambiguous serialized approval replays and replaces rejected function-tool final output in SDK-owned replay surfaces, limiting unsafe re-entry into model context.
actionable_takeaway: Adopt a Replay-Safe Guardrail Contract for live RunState, serialized checkpoints, new runs and application-owned logs.

title: ChatGPT & Codex changelog remains the canonical model and product-entry source
author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
why_it_matters: Model availability, Codex entry points and product rollout language can diverge from local CLI state or third-party client assumptions.
actionable_takeaway: Keep a Changelog-vs-Local Readback step: compare public OpenAI changelog, local CLI version, account rollout and automation defaults.

title: ChatGPT Business release notes keep expanding app-triggered tasks and plugin surfaces
author: OpenAI Help Center
why_it_matters: Scheduled tasks, app updates, plugin marketplaces and cross-app messaging continue to blur the line between reminder, draft and external action.
actionable_takeaway: For every app-triggered task, record trigger schema, idempotency key, owner, allowed actions and send/publish approval boundary.

title: ChatGPT release notes reinforce host-vs-control device separation
author: OpenAI Help Center
why_it_matters: Session visibility, app directory wording, computer-use expansion and remote steering all require clear distinction between control plane and execution host.
actionable_takeaway: Update the Agent Session Policy Matrix with host device, control device, data boundary, retention and final evidence.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases show workbench controls moving into shared sessions and defaults
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Shared sessions, CLI defaults, session restore and model usage visibility point to coding agents becoming managed workbenches rather than one-off chats.
actionable_takeaway: Document default mode, permission mode, restore behavior, plugin/MCP surface, skills and model usage for every repeatable agent workbench.

title: GitHub Copilot policy and billing changes converge cloud agent, github.com Chat and Mobile
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Mobile, browser and cloud-agent surfaces are being pulled into unified policy and billing rules, which changes default access and review assumptions.
actionable_takeaway: Review organization policy, mobile access, retention, billing impact and review effort before relying on mobile/cloud agent defaults.

title: Copilot code review expands to bot-authored and larger pull requests
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: AI-authored PRs can now receive AI review, making reviewer independence and evidence quality more important than a binary reviewed flag.
actionable_takeaway: Add an Author/Reviewer Independence Gate with author type, reviewer type, tests, affected risk areas and resolution reason.

title: Claude Code hooks remain a useful lifecycle reference for agent workflows
author: Anthropic Docs
why_it_matters: Hook-style lifecycle events are a practical vocabulary for pre-tool, post-tool, stop and notification gates, even when implemented in another agent stack.
actionable_takeaway: Map hook concepts to Codex-specific events, permissions and evidence fields before copying any behavior.

title: Agent Fleet turns Obsidian vaults into agent task, skill and run-log workspaces
author: Obsidian Community
why_it_matters: Markdown vaults are becoming personal agent workbenches, which can improve memory but also risk silent knowledge-asset mutation.
actionable_takeaway: Use a Vault-Agent Ownership Fence: read/search first, write only to approved folders, require backup and diff before move/delete/merge automation.
